data.name: Nimay
data.gender_notes: Nimay is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nimitta', meaning 'indicator' or 'deity'. In Hindu mythology, Nimay refers to the divine architect and creator of the universe, Lord Brahma. The name Nimay carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nimay usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine power and creative force in the universe.
data.etymology: Nimay belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nimay total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.spiritual_significance: For Hindus, the name Nimay holds immense spiritual significance. It is a reminder of the divine presence and the interconnectedness of all things in the universe.
